prompt.sw: Ipi kati ya hizi ni ishara ya hatari ya utapeli?
prompt.en: Which of these is a red flag for a scam?

label.en: An app that shows you your address
A friend explaining what bitcoin is

explanation.sw: Hakuna anayeweza kuhakikisha faida kwa bitcoin. Ahadi hiyo ni ishara kubwa ya utapeli.
explanation.en: Nobody can guarantee a return on bitcoin. That promise is a major scam signal.

prompt.sw: Mtu anayejiita msimamizi wa Bitsacco anakuomba utume sats kwanza ili upokee mara mbili. Ufanye nini?
prompt.en: Someone calling themselves a Bitsacco admin asks you to send sats first to receive double. What should you do?

label.en: Send a small amount to test it

explanation.sw: "Tuma kwanza upokee zaidi" daima ni utapeli, hata kwa kiasi kidogo.
explanation.en: "Send first to receive more" is always a scam, even for a small amount.

prompt.sw: Umetapeliwa. Mtu anajitolea kukurudishia bitcoin yako kwa ada. Ufanye nini?
prompt.en: You've been scammed. Someone offers to recover your bitcoin for a fee. What should you do?

label.en: Ignore it; it is another scam

label.sw: Kumpa maneno yako ya siri ili afuatilie
label.en: Give them your seed phrase so they can trace it

explanation.sw: Malipo ya Bitcoin hayarudishwi. "Huduma za kurejesha" huwalenga waliotapeliwa tayari.
explanation.en: Bitcoin payments can't be reversed. "Recovery services" target people who were already scammed.

prompt.sw: Maneno yako ya siri yalionekana na mtu mwingine. Hatua ya kwanza ni ipi?
prompt.en: Your seed phrase was seen by someone else. What is the first step?

label.sw: Kuhamisha pesa zilizobaki kwenye pochi mpya yenye maneno mapya
label.en: Move the remaining funds to a new wallet with a new seed phrase
Wait to see if they steal it

explanation.sw: Maneno yaliyoonekana hayawezi kufanywa siri tena. Pochi mpya tu ndiyo salama.
explanation.en: Exposed words can't be made secret again. Only a new wallet is safe.
